design_request: 研究者重建任务：为两位短住旅客完成6米×5米房间的家具布置。已有固定厨房操作台、灶台、水槽和三件卫浴设施；保留房壳、开口和这些设施。使用目录补齐睡眠、起居、两人吃饭、冷藏及便于取放衣物所需的家具，保持入口、餐位、厨卫与窗前可接近。不得删除必需角色或缩放资产。人数与短住用途来自项目说明；矩形房壳、精确尺寸、设施、替代家具及具体要求整理为研究者重建，不是原住户任务书。
unknowns: 6x5x2.6m rectangular shell, internal bath, openings and placements are research assumptions; only approximately 30m² and two short-stay visitors are source context.
Freestanding double-rail substitutes for original metal pipe, adding floor footprint and not reproducing original mounting.
Sleeping/cooking/bathroom/under-bed storage represented by unvalidated proxies; no capacity, services, physical reach, load or comfort claim.
Door leaves hypothetically open for route measurements; square body sizes/grid/clearance are declared proxies, not standards.
Real clothing reach, load, capacity and bed storage are unknown.
The freestanding rail substitutes for a mounted pipe and has a different floor footprint.
All positions and construction order are researcher reconstruction; fixtures are supplied.
No historical identity preservation; seven new instances.
Room/fixture proxies and functional limits retained; no independent evaluation or training authorization.
